name: graphity-ts
description: Graphity for TypeScript and JavaScript: graph analysis on a compact, immutable CSR graph, as the packages @kobayami/graphity-core, -controlflow, -dot and -mermaid, and @kobayami/graphity for all of them
author: Marco Kaufmann (https://github.com/kaufco)

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/controlflow packages/dot packages/mermaid packages/graphity
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/controlflow packages/dot packages/mermaid packages/graphity && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/controlflow/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/dot/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/mermaid/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/graphity/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/examples && tsc -p packages/consumer-check
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/controlflow packages/dot packages/mermaid packages/graphity
